properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (root-cause skill, measured) 2026-10-26: a choice an agent settles under a standing delegation is recorded exactly like a choice the owner settled himself, so it reads as the owner's approval
properties.statement: SYMPTOM (a designer agent on a sample shop design, flo2.io, reflow2 0.92.0): "every decision I set to accepted and every gap I ruled on is recorded as approved by who:ajs, although I made them under the standing decision". MEASURED, read-only: an agent-made choice (dec:sample-choice-capabilities-for-anthonys-parts) and the owner's own standing decision (dec:the-sample-closes-its-gaps-with-reasonable-choices-each-justified-in-the-design) carry IDENTICAL attribution: AUTHORED_BY who:ajs roles [author, approver], authored_via and approved_via [who:agent-d82ad83a71]. CANDIDATES AND WHAT DECIDED THEM. (a) reflow2 records no agent: REFUTED, the ACTS_FOR stamp (#632) is present on both. (b) reflow2 has no record of WHICH delegation an approval was made under: CONFIRMED. The only link is a GOVERNED_BY edge plus prose ("made by the agent under ..."); dec:idea-a-standing-delegation-to-an-agent-is-a-record-with-an-escalation-boundary was DEFERRED on 2026-10-13, so there is no delegation record and no approval role between "approver" and "author". (c) readers drop the stamp: CONFIRMED in part. In v0.92.0 role_via() has one reader, loop_status's acted_through (report.rs:721); foundations and reason_to_exist say "accepted by its owner" (inference.rs:3486, reason_to_exist.rs:291) without reading approved_via, and flo2's public design page (approversOf, public-design-page.ts:237) shows only the approver's name. (d) OUTSIDE reflow2, flo2: the agent id is derived per OAuth client / User-Agent product (agent.ts), so every Claude Code session on this account, the owner's own chat included, is the same who:agent-d82ad83a71. Even a reader that showed approved_via could not tell the owner typing through Claude Code from an autonomous designer. CONFIRMED by the identical stamp above. (e) The observation is wrong: PARTLY. The agent IS recorded, but in a field nothing the designer read shows. CLASS: attribution was built (who acted) without the authority it acted under (by whose standing word), and the agent identity is per client, not per actor. NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the gap acknowledgements on this design carry approved_via (the ack writer goes through the same stamped edge write, so expected yes, not read); whether the owner wants a delegation to count as his word at all (rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word, and his 2026-10-13 deferral). RECOMMENDED, by correctness: (1) owner rules first on whether a standing delegation is ever valid; if yes, reflow2 builds option (b)+(c) of the deferred idea (a delegation record, cited by each settlement, a role such as approved_under, read by foundations/loop_status/detect_defects); (2) flo2 gives each agent seat its own identity (req:an-ai-agent-holds-its-own-flo2-account-answered-for-by-a-named-person) so the via-stamp separates owner-through-a-client from agent; (3) readers that say "accepted by its owner" say "through agent X" when approved_via is set.
